step.process_name: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K moisture-cure polyurethane)

events.label: Recipe history
events.detail: Found in 4 archived recipe revision(s); first seen 2001-10-22.

evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
evidence.claim: Step is in the current recipe (RECIPE CARD - TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)).

evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
evidence.claim: Earliest archived recipe revision containing the step is dated 2001-10-22.
evidence.quote: 1. Add 2 kg molecular sieve 3A per batch.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2001-014
evidence.claim: In 2001, molecular sieve 3A was added to TL-5 to absorb residual water from polyol PS-400.
evidence.quote: add 2 kg molecular sieve 3A per batch to absorb residual water from polyol PS-400

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2001-019
evidence.claim: In 2001, TL-5 cans bulged at a customer due to high water content in Polioli Sereni polyol PS-400.
evidence.quote: cans bulging at a customer (domed lids). Carbon dioxide formed by the reaction of isocyanate with water.

evidence.title: Laboratory report LT-2018-022 - water content of TL-5
evidence.claim: In 2018, lab tests showed that the molecular sieve addition had a negligible effect on reducing water content in TL-5.
evidence.quote: The molecular sieve addition reduces water by less than 0.002 % - not measurable within the method error.

evidence.title: Commissioning record EQ-2013-004 - vacuum dryer VD-1
evidence.claim: In 2013, a vacuum dryer VD-1 was introduced for TL-5 to ensure polyol water content is below 0.05%.
evidence.quote: Vacuum dryer VD-1 for polyol: drying at 90 °C / 20 mbar to water below 0.05 %

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2016-005 - Nordpol Chemicals AB, NP-310 Dry
evidence.claim: In 2016, Nordpol Chemicals NP-310 Dry replaced Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5, guaranteeing water content below 0.03%.
evidence.quote: Replaces Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5.

evidence.title: FATTURA / INVOICE n. 7620/25
evidence.claim: Nordpol Chemicals NP-310 Dry was still being supplied for use in 2025.
evidence.quote: Item: Polyol NP-310 Dry, tank truck. Quantity: 400 kg.

verdict.process_name: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K moisture-cure polyurethane)
verdict.reason: The step was added to absorb residual water from polyol PS-400 to prevent can bulging (E3, E4). PS-400 was replaced in 2016 by NP-310 Dry, which guarantees lower water content (E7), and a vacuum dryer VD-1 was introduced in 2013 to ensure water levels below 0.05% (E6).

chain.claim: Molecular sieve 3A was added to absorb residual water from polyol PS-400
High water content in PS-400 caused cans to bulge due to CO2 formation
Vacuum dryer VD-1 was introduced in 2013 to ensure water content below 0.05%
Polioli Sereni PS-400 was replaced by Nordpol Chemicals NP-310 Dry in 2016

counter_evidence.claim: Molecular sieve addition has a negligible effect on reducing water content
counter_evidence.resolution: Supports the conclusion that the step is no longer effective/necessary
